# HandDerp

**Category:** Fun  
**Aliases:** HandDerp

## What it does

HandDerp is a cosmetic prank module that rapidly flips your main hand back and forth between left and right. The result is a jittery, "derping" look as your held item and arm constantly swap sides — purely for fun, with no impact on combat or movement. Like Derp , SkinDerp , and Twerk , it's meant to mess around and make your character look silly.

Description basis: [publisher description](https://liquidbounce.net/docs/modules/fun/handderp). The module's behavior on a stock Minecraft 26.3 server has not been verified unless separately documented in [research](../../RESEARCH.md).
